description: [Kyreos, 0.02 USDC per call via x402 on Base] Every USDC payment into any x402 payTo on Base, read live from chain (eth_getLogs): payer, amount, tx, block, time, totals, distinct payers, top 10 payers, last settlement. 1-72 h window. Verified against a real wallet before listing. Input: {"address":"0x... Base payTo","hours":24}. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/settlement-ledger?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.02 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (0.02 USDC on Base)
